title: Telemetry credit buckets and security-questionnaire auto-attach experiment for add-on gating
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Objective: Run a controlled experiment that introduces per-customer telemetry credit buckets as a purchasable add-on, and couple the compliance pack (security questionnaire auto-attach) to eligible customers via entitlement gating. Hypothesis: Offering predictable telemetry buckets will reduce overage support incidents and make observability retention an upsell; auto-attaching the SQ/compliance pack for qualifying contracts will shorten procurement cycles and increase conversion for mid-enterprise deals.
scope: MVP: add two telemetry tiers (standard 30d, extended 90d) behind an add-on toggle; implement server-side entitlement check in Console + API to show availability; wire up contract metadata so that when 'compliance_pack' entitlement is present the standard Enterprise SQ PDF is attached automatically during contract generation. Exclude: pricing model-wide changes, on-prem packaging and HSM integrations (separate workstream).
success_metrics: % of customers who upgrade to telemetry add-on within 90 days
reduction in overage tickets related to retention by >30% for pilot cohort
time-to-sign for contracts with auto-attached SQ reduced by 20%
Net Revenue Retention delta for pilot customers
monitoring_playbook: Dashboard: pilot cohort telemetry usage, retention-related errors, cost-per-token delta. Alerts: (1) 5%+ spike in KV-cache misses after retention change, (2) contract generation failures when SQ attach flag set. Postmortem required for any contract doc failures.
risks: Legal/regulatory objections to auto-attaching security artifacts - mitigated via consent checkbox in contract flow
Billing integration complexity across Dedicated customers
Accidental exposure of longer retention to customers without entitlement due to cache invalidation bug
rollout_plan: Week 1: feature flag behind 'telemetry-addons' for internal testing; Week 2: invite-only pilot with 8 customers (sales nominated); Week 4: evaluate metrics and legal feedback; Week 6: open beta to tiered customers. All rollouts will be gated by feature-flag and monitored by an SRE runbook.
ux_changes: Console: Add 'Observability Add-ons' panel on Account Settings with purchase button and toggle to request trial; Contract UI shows 'Attach compliance pack (SQ)' checkbox when entitlement present. Design mocks in Figma linked below.
pricing_notes: Initial price anchors: telemetry-30d add-on = +$1,200/mo; telemetry-90d add-on = +$2,500/mo. Pilot will test price elasticity; final pricing will be set after 6 weeks of pilot data. Economists to provide margin thresholds.
legal_and_compliance: Legal to vet the standard SQ PDF and approve auto-attach language. Need a short consent clause and opt-out path for customers that refuse automatic attachment. Security review required prior to beta.
